gen-dafont-quantum-fs-synonym: Synonym draws a plain sans stripe of constant ink, with generous openings in every curve. Under Quantum's loose, spaced-out display letters, a longer stretch of it moves along smoothly, with nothing snagging the eye.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-almendra: Dignified and bookish, Almendra carries a deep midsection in its lowercase, while Quantum above it stays outline-plain and techy. And a longer passage in that text serif would read with a slow, old-fashioned gravity against the clean heading.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-port-lligat-slab: Literary and traditional, Port Lligat Slab has lowercase counters like wide glass portholes and curves left open at the ends. And over a longer stretch it reads warmly and steadily, a classic serif that offsets Quantum's pen-fixed, tech-clean strokes.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-quando: Quando reads sparse and wide-spaced, its tall middle zone making each word feel unhurried, like a text serif from an older bookshelf. And Quantum, with no stroke contrast at all, sits above it with clean, compressed ascenders that tighten the whole look.
gen-dafont-quantum-plus-jakarta-sans: Quantum leads with loose letterfit and compressed ascenders, a tech-clean display face with lots of breathing space. Plus Jakarta Sans follows with monoline sans-serif precision, and its higher, steadier lowercase is the pair's strongest single quality.
gen-dafont-quantum-space-grotesk: Techy, spacious and crisp at the top. Space Grotesk then carries a longer passage as a ribbon of constant width, its counters hollow and open, so the reading feels light and even-paced.
gen-dafont-redux-fs-amulya: Wide-set, geometric and tilted toward a big lowercase, Redux has heavier verticals tugging against lighter horizontals. Amulya, a modern sans-serif, keeps its curve gaps generous.
gen-dafont-redux-fs-spline-sans: Redux spreads its letters wide, with a big visible entrance into every curve and sturdy hairlines beside moderate stems. Spline Sans reads approachably and smoothly over a longer page.
gen-dafont-redux-fs-synonym: A gentle ebb and flow of stroke weight gives Redux its wide-spaced, geometric personality. Synonym is the steady foil, a plain sans of constant ink with generous curves, and that calm against the swelling heading is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-almendra: Almendra, a classic serif with a deep lowercase midsection, brings a bookish dignity to the page. Redux sits beside it wide-spaced and geometric, its strokes tapering gently from stem to joint, so the two feel like old and new in conversation.
